How to Build an Invoicing Tool for Paralegals with Base44

Understanding the Needs of Paralegals

Paralegals require a unique set of features in an invoicing tool, including the ability to track time spent on cases, generate invoices, and manage client payments. With Base44, you can create a custom app that meets these specific needs, without requiring any coding knowledge. The platform's intuitive interface and drag-and-drop functionality make it easy to design and build a tailored invoicing solution.

Before you start building your invoicing tool, take some time to consider the specific features you need. Make a list of the key functions you want your app to perform, such as:

  • Time tracking and management
  • Invoice generation and customization
  • Client payment management and tracking
  • Integration with existing case management systems
